instruction: Follow the app's flow (using the static analysis guidance) from launch until it triggers the Accessibility Service prompt and navigates to System Accessibility Settings. Do NOT toggle a malicious service ON.

elements.text: Choose what to allow Flash Update to access
access photos, media, and files on your device

all_texts: Choose what to allow Flash Update to access

Action: I'll tap "Continue" to grant the listed runtime permissions so the app can proceed to its Accessibility prompt.
